author: Justin W
html: Thanks for sharing your journey. I realize I’m a little late, but I was wondering if you could give some details on the differences between countries when it came to bike safety and how you dealt with it.

author: Basile
html: The bicycle trip overall was relatively safe. I would recommend wearing a bike helmet which addresses the number one risk. Then, Pakistan will be a bit trickier but not impossible if you do it carefully. Regardless of the place, it is harder as a woman, i recommend to have a male friend. Many couples travel through all those countries without any problem. Besides, always listen to your gut. If it feels dangerous, don’t do it. Ask other people around.
